title: 🤖 Qt library error

messages.content: unknown:0 Cannot mix incompatible Qt library (5.15.14) with this library (5.15.8)
unknown:0 Cannot mix incompatible Qt library (5.15.14) with this library (5.15.8)

[Denis Oliver Kropp | System Software Engineer] Incompatible Qt libraries are being used. The error message indicates that the current project is trying to use Qt library version 5.15.8, but it's also attempting to link against another Qt library with version 5.15.14. This can happen if different parts of the project were compiled with different versions of Qt.

To resolve this issue, you should ensure that all parts of your project are compiled with the same version of Qt. If you're using a build tool like CMake or qmake, check your configuration files to make sure they are set up to use the same Qt version everywhere. If you're building manually, verify that you're linking against the correct Qt library version.

It might also help to clean your build directory and rebuild everything from scratch after ensuring the Qt version consistency across your project settings. 

Additionally, consider updating both to a newer version if possible, especially since these versions seem somewhat outdated compared to more recent Qt releases.
